summary: Iteration 84 — Retest of iter83 HIGH (tfadeup override on .tcard) + MEDIUM (Site Mode save toast) + regression of the expansion from 18 to 39 box animations. HIGH BUG FIXED: on /p/pv_c3b797fcdafc58d4e70e320f a .tcard.cm-box.cm-in now reports the correct computed animationName='cma-<key>' (verified live for bounce, spin, dissolve, blinds, checkerboard, spiral-in) with the per-key duration from BOX_ANIMS (0.8-0.9s). The old `.dsv2 .tstagger-in.tstagger > *` tfadeup rule is now scoped with :not(.cm-box) and .cm-box.cm-in has !important on animation-duration/delay/fill-mode, so headings/paragraphs still animate via tfadeup while .cm-box (cards + non-card boxes) run their cma-* keyframes. Non-card cm-boxes on the same page also correctly report cma-<key> (verified for the same 6 keys). MEDIUM FIXED: patch() in SiteModePanel now retries once after 1300ms on HTTP 429 before showing the error toast (code review confirmed at lines 86-95). CSS AUDIT (grep+diff): index.css has 38 @keyframes cma-* + a special-cased cm-a-none override = 39 total, and 39 .cm-a-<key>.cm-in selectors. Every key in BOX_ANIMS matches a keyframe; every keyframe has a selector — no typos, no orphans. BACKEND: 79/79 pytest pass (test_iter83 22/22 with the length-18→39 fix, plus iter80/81/82 regression). options.box_anims is length 39 and set-equals VALID_KEYS; every one of the 39 keys is accepted by PUT and persisted through a follow-up GET; unknown key still 400s with 'Unknown box entrance animation'; empty string still clears the override. FRONTEND: 44 .cm-box tagged (matches iter83), 0 nested .cm-box-inside-.cm-box, 0 absolute/fixed leaks, IntersectionObserver replay still toggles cm-in on both directions (getAnimations() returns a fresh cma-<key> animation each re-entry). Site Mode picker renders 39 BOX_ANIMS options + 1 inherit option = 40 <option> nodes (verified from source: `{BOX_ANIMS.map(a => <option .../>)}` on line 192 of SiteModePanel.tsx). Reduced-motion path: with box_anim='' set for teardown, tstagger children reported opacity>=0.9 (0 hidden), confirming the :not(.cm-box) change did not orphan any element at opacity 0.4. TEARDOWN: box_anim reset to '' on app_testlab. NOT VERIFIED live: team-section per-block override (block-team not present on app_testlab tenant pages, /templates gallery still Cloudflare-gated for anonymous automation) and full 39-key card sweep — 6 keys directly confirmed live, the remaining 33 verified structurally (keyframe+selector exist, per-key duration wired via CSS var, backend accepts and persists each). Test-harness limitation: rapid PUTs got rate-limited (Cloudflare 429), and rapid scroll sweeps sometimes removed cm-in before I could read computedStyle (test artefact, not a code bug — spiral-in for example passed once observer settled).

rca of the issue: iter83 HIGH RCA: `.dsv2 .tstagger-in.tstagger > *` (specificity 0,3,1) declared `animation: tfadeup .65s ...` and won over `.cm-a-<key>.cm-in { animation-name: cma-<key>; }` (0,2,0) on every .tcard. Fix landed in iter84: (a) tenant-v2.css scopes all four tstagger rules with `:not(.cm-box)`, so .cm-box never inherits tfadeup at all; (b) index.css .cm-box.cm-in now sets animation-duration/delay/fill-mode with !important, providing a defence-in-depth against any future stagger regressions. Verified live: getComputedStyle on .tcard.cm-box.cm-a-bounce.cm-in returns animationName='cma-bounce' duration=0.9s (was tfadeup/0.65s in iter83). iter83 MEDIUM RCA: single 429 from the site-mode PUT (Cloudflare rate limit under rapid selection) surfaced 'Could not save Site Mode' with no retry. Fix: patch() now retries once after 1.3s on 429 before falling through to the error toast.
